what_is_closed: J02 Table 4.3 is classified as a source-overlap comparator rather than an independent He-II response test of the current local He-4 calibration.
equation_or_mapping: alpha_Phi_K = (rho_s/rho)|T0 / d_T(rho_s/rho)|T0; direct Table 4.3 rows were not fitted, but the adopted Section 2 rho_s database partly derives from sound measurements.
units: alpha_Phi_K: K per normalized base Phi; Table 4.3 second-sound velocity: m s^-1
derivation_class: source-lineage and measurement-method audit, not a new physical derivation
observable: He-II superfluid fraction calibration versus second-sound phase-velocity comparator

source_locators.locator: Section 2 adopted superfluid-density data and Table 2.1; Section 4 second-sound data and Tables 4.1 and 4.3
source_locators.finding: The Section 2 adopted database includes Maynard and Tam-Ahlers sound-derived superfluid-density measurements in the calibration temperature window; Section 4 draws on overlapping second-sound study families. Exact row-level covariance is not specified by the recommended tables.
First-, second-, and fourth-sound velocities were measured for the thermodynamic-property reconstruction.

claim_boundary: The He-4 alpha remains a local calibration independent of graphite TTG/Xie target fitting, but J02 is not an independent or blind He-II validation. This audit does not change the numeric alpha, G0, or Full Topic 13 readiness.
